snippet.title: ANOKYE GAME PROUDLY MADE IN GHANA by Mills Media
snippet.description:
Step into the world of ANOKYE 

A proud and authentic Ghanaian game inspired by our legends and culture.
Download now using the link below and experience African storytelling like never before. 🎮🔥 Anokye is available on iOS Appstore, Google Playstore and on STEAM for PC

Click to download: https://onelink.to/r3n6d2
